subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 13 updated third-party action implementations in credentialed CI and Codex workflows after direct upstream-contract review and final-head workflow evidence?
rationale: The remaining choice is whether the changed privileged action contracts are acceptable for repository automation; it cannot be resolved safely from a pin-only diff or Dependabot release metadata.

options.title: Review and merge after evidence
options.body: Verify the privileged action release contracts and attach redacted final-head workflow evidence before accepting the SHA updates.

options.title: Pause this dependency group
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until the workflow/security owner can review the updated action behavior and credential boundaries.

recommendation.title: Review and merge after evidence
recommendation.body: Verify the privileged action release contracts and attach redacted final-head workflow evidence before accepting the SHA updates.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available owner for a repository-wide privileged-workflow acceptance decision, though file-history ownership could not be confirmed in this read-only environment.
